messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App that works on localhost crashes on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi Vojtech,
Typically when you see that "killed" line in your JavaScript console, it indicates that the application has taken up the maximum amount of memory alotted to the instance.  I see that you have already configured your application to be an xxlarge.  Is it possible that your running application takes up more memory as more and more users interact with it?

I also noticed this error in your logs (shinyapps::showLogs())  I don't believe it should be a contributor but I thought I would highlight it.

Warning in matrix(align.tmp[(2 - pos):(ncol(x) + 1)], nrow = nrow(x), ncol = ncol(x) +  :

2014-11-06T12:41:19.345632+00:00 shinyapps[shuttle]:   data length exceeds size of matrix


As for your question about availability of pricing and such, we are actually a day or two away from announcing our proposed pricing for the service once it is generally available.  We expect to move the service into Beta in the coming weeks, and to move it to GA in early Q1 of next year. 

-Tareef
